status.description: pr_updated only if the push succeeded and the rework and review labels are cleared

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the rework changed and how it was verified

not_applied.description: A request left unmet, with the reason given in the PR body

tests.description: The two gates of D07 as you ran them last on the final tree; the sandbox records each run and refuses a push without a green one for every side you changed

backend.description: 'green: <summary line of ./gradlew check>' or 'not applicable: backend untouched'

frontend.description: 'green: <summary line of npm test>' or 'not applicable: frontend untouched'

blocker.description: Required when blocked: the question, or the exact error that survived three fixes
